fullContentHtml:
HPSC Civil Service Mains Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the mains result for the recruitment of Civil Services Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 102 posts. Applications for the HPSC Haryana Civil Service HCS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from February 06, 2026, to February 26, 2026. The mains examination was held on 27, 28 & 29 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their HPSC Civil Service HCS Mains Result 2026 from the link given below.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is HPSC Civil Service Mains Result 2026?

HPSC Civil Service Mains Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://hpsc.gov.in/en-us/

How to download result?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
